questions: Can you tell me about Karthipuram?
What kind of project is this?
How many acres is the project?
Give me an overview of the project
entries.answer: Karthipuram is a 190-acre integrated township in Coimbatore with residential and commercial plots, parks, wide roads and full underground infrastructure. It's built so everything you need is inside the township.
facts: Integrated township with residential and commercial plots
Located in Coimbatore, the Manchester of South India
Tagline: Step through the door to your dream place

questions: What are the key numbers of the project?
entries.answer: In 190 acres we have 1,882 housing plots and 213 commercial plots, 10 parks including a 9-acre central park, over 1,200 trees, 15 entrance ways and three types of water connection.

questions: Who is the promoter of Karthipuram?
Which company is behind this project?
entries.answer: Karthipuram is developed by Unnamalai Promoters Private Limited, part of the Unnamalai Group. The founder is Thiru P. Karthikeyan. They have been developing layouts across Tamil Nadu since 1989.

questions: What other projects have you done?
How long have you been in business?
How many projects have you delivered?
entries.answer: We have been developing since 1989, with projects across Kovilpatti, Tirupur, Dindugul, Dharapuram, Gobi, Sathy and Sulur. Our largest so far was 850 acres at Kovilpatti New Town, and we also built two colleges.
facts: 2002 Kovilpatti New Town Suba Nagar, 850 acres
2011 Naveen Nagar and Soundaraja Airport Nagar, Dindugul, 63 acres
2019 Unnamalai Nagar, Sathvika Nagar, Adhvitha Nagar, Tirupur, 11 acres
2020 Unnamalai College of Arts and Science, Kovilpatti

questions: Is the project on Avinashi Road?
How do I reach the site?
Is it near Kathir Engineering College?
entries.answer: The site is on Avinashi Road, Neelambur, near Kathir Engineering College Road in Coimbatore, on the Kalapatti to Arasur State Highway Road.
facts: Avinashi Road, Neelambur, Kathir Engineering College Road, Coimbatore
On the Kalapatti to Arasur SH Road
Near PSG iTech and Kathir Engineering College

entries.topic: Why Neelambur is a good location
questions: Why should I buy in Neelambur?
Why is Neelambur a good location?
What are the advantages of this location?
What is the growth potential here?
entries.answer: Neelambur has excellent connectivity and a strategic location, with airport expansion, highway and metro projects nearby, a growing logistics hub, strong economic momentum and steady price appreciation.

questions: Is there a bus stop nearby?
How do I travel to the city from there?
How do I get to the airport from the site?
Is it easy to commute from here?
How do people get around from the township?
entries.answer: Connectivity is one of the strongest points here. The township sits on the Kalapatti to Arasur State Highway Road just off Avinashi Road, with fifteen entrance ways onto eighty and sixty foot roads, so getting in and out is easy. The airport is close by, and highway and metro projects are coming up around Neelambur.
facts: On the Kalapatti to Arasur State Highway Road, off Avinashi Road, Neelambur
Coimbatore International Airport is among the facilities close to the site
15 entrance ways into the township, onto 80 and 60-feet roads
Highway and Metro Projects listed among the Neelambur location advantages
No metro station inside the township itself

questions: Is there a metro station inside the township?
Is the metro coming to Neelambur?
Is there a metro line here?
When will the metro be ready?
entries.answer: There's no metro station inside the township itself. Metro and highway projects are part of why we highlight Neelambur's connectivity, and for the status of any specific line our team can confirm the latest.
facts: No metro station inside the township
Highway and Metro Projects are listed among the Neelambur location advantages
Timelines for specific transport projects are not given in the brochure

entries.topic: Why buy a plot instead of a flat
questions: Why should I buy a plot instead of a flat?
Why are plots better than apartments?
What are the benefits of owning a plot?
Can I build my own house?
Can I design my home the way I want?
Can I expand my house later?
Can I rent out the property?
Can I sell the plot later?
Is a plot a good investment?
entries.answer: With a plot you get full ownership of the land, and land value keeps rising faster. You can build your dream home your way, expand anytime, and sell or rent whenever you choose.
facts: Build your dream home your way

entries.topic: How many plots and what types
questions: How many residential plots are there?
How many housing plots are available?
How many commercial plots are there?
What types of plots do you have?
entries.answer: The township has 1,882 housing plots and 213 commercial plots.

questions: What is the road width inside the township?
How much road network is there?
entries.answer: We have 80, 60 and 40-feet tar roads, with the 80 and 60-feet roads stretching over 4 kilometres. There are 15 entrance ways into the township.

questions: How big is the central park?
What facilities are in the parks?
Is there a children's play area?
Is there a cricket practice net?
entries.answer: There are 10 parks including a beautifully landscaped 9-acre central park at the heart of the township, designed for morning walks, family time and community gatherings.

questions: Can I see the Nilgiri mountains?
Can I see the Aanaikatti hills?
entries.answer: We have over 1,200 trees and 10 parks. The site sits at the highest altitude in the surrounding region, so you get views of the Nilgiri mountains to the north and sunsets over the Aanaikatti hills to the west, with a cool evening breeze.
facts: Highest altitude in the surrounding region
Nilgiri Mountains view to the north
Sunset over Aanaikatti hills to the west

questions: Is there a school in the township?
Will there be a school inside?
Do you have your own school?
Will my children have a school nearby?
entries.answer: A school inside the township is proposed, so children can skip long bus travel. I should be clear that it is planned, not yet built.
facts: School is listed as Proposed in the brochure
Intended to avoid long school commutes

questions: Are there schools close to the project?
Is there a good school near the site?
entries.answer: Within 15 minutes you have Yellow Train School, GRD-CPF School, Reeds World School, Indian Public School, Chandramari International School and Sri Chaitanya Techno School.

questions: Are there engineering colleges close by?
What colleges are around the project?
entries.answer: Within 15 minutes you have Kathir College of Arts and Science, Kathir Engineering College, Adithya Arts and Engineering College, PSG iTech and GRD College of Education.

questions: Do you have a mall in the township?
entries.answer: A shopping mall is proposed inside the township, bringing fine dining, luxury retail and entertainment together. It is planned rather than built today.
facts: Mall is listed as Proposed in the brochure
Fine dining, luxury retail shopping and entertainment

questions: Can I buy daily essentials inside?
Will I need to travel outside for shopping?
How long are the shopping streets?
What kind of shops will there be?
entries.answer: Over 4 kilometres of our 80 and 60-feet roads become vibrant shopping streets, with boutiques, jewellery, textiles, watches, footwear and everyday essentials, so you don't have to drive across the city.
facts: Over 4 kilometres of shopping streets on 80 and 60-feet roads

questions: Are there restaurants in the township?
Can I dine inside the township?
entries.answer: Fine dining, luxury retail and entertainment are planned as part of the township, including a signature restaurant at the recreational club.
facts: Fine dining and entertainment planned in the mall
Signature restaurant at the recreational club
Mall and club are both listed as Proposed

questions: What is in the recreational club?
Is there a gym or fitness studio?
Is there a restaurant in the club?
Can I host functions or meetings?
entries.answer: A recreational club is proposed with a swimming pool, modern fitness studio, indoor games, a signature restaurant and elegant meeting spaces. It's planned, not built yet.
facts: Club is listed as Proposed in the brochure

questions: Why is there a media tower?
Does the township have digital displays?
Is the media tower lit at night?
entries.answer: A 52-feet Media Tower stands at the centre of the grand boulevard, with LED pixels and smart displays showing community updates, advertisements and cultural events. At night its illumination makes it a landmark.
facts: At the centre of Karthipuram's grand boulevard
Advanced LED pixels and dynamic smart displays
Real-time information, branding and interactive experiences
Community updates, advertisements, cultural events, global content

questions: Does the township have underground infrastructure?
What is laid under the roads?
Will there be electricity poles inside?
How is the infrastructure protected from storms?
entries.answer: Everything runs underground. Under our roads we've laid six services: Bhavani water, borewell water, Athikadavu water, the sewage line, Fibernet cable and electricity cable. So no messy poles and no storm damage.
facts: Six underground services under the roads
Insulated cables run in concrete ducts

entries.answer: Electricity comes through insulated underground cables running in concrete ducts. No messy poles, no storm damage, just safe and reliable power for your home and business.

questions: Can I work from home there?
entries.answer: High-speed fiber optics are laid securely underground, so you get seamless browsing, video calls, streaming and smart-home connectivity without interruptions.
facts: Supports browsing, video calls, streaming, smart home

questions: Is sewage connected to every plot?
entries.answer: Underground sewage pipelines run at the centre of the roads and connect to every plot. An advanced Sewage Treatment Plant purifies the wastewater and reuses it for the greenery, keeping the township clean, odour-free and mosquito-free.
facts: Underground sewage pipelines at the centre of roads

entries.answer: Modern storm water drains run along both sides of the roads with recharge pits at frequent intervals. That prevents waterlogging and also helps raise the groundwater level.
facts: Storm water drains on either side of the roads

questions: What are the three water sources?
How is water supplied to the plots?
Do I need my own borewell?
Tell me about the water supply
How many water connections are there?
entries.answer: We have an assured triple water supply: L and T Bhavani water from the Bhavani river, Athikadavu water from Pillur Dam, and bore water through a centralised system for the whole township. So no individual borewell is needed and no water scarcity.
facts: L&T Bhavani Water from the Bhavani River
Athikadavu Water from Pillur Dam, from the Nilgiri forests, clean and cool
Bore Water through a centralised bore system for the entire township
Covers drinking, cooking, gardening and daily household use

questions: How many street lights are there?
Is the township lit at night?
Is it safe to walk at night?
entries.answer: The township has 650 street lights, so the roads are well lit at night.
The township has CCTV surveillance and a compound wall around it, with 15 controlled entrance ways.

questions: Give me the full list of amenities
What do I get in this township?
entries.answer: You get 80, 60 and 40-feet tar roads, all utilities underground, an STP plant, storm water drainage with recharge pits, 650 street lights, 1,200 trees, 10 parks with a 9-acre main park, sports and play areas, CCTV, a compound wall and the 52-feet Media Tower. The school, mall and club are proposed.
facts: Rain water drainage with recharge pits

questions: What is the current stage of the project?
entries.answer: The school, the mall and the recreational club are all marked as proposed in our brochure. The roads, underground utilities, parks and water infrastructure are part of the layout plan. For the exact current build status I'll have our sales team confirm.
facts: Brochure designs and specifications are indicative and provisional
Promoter reserves the right to modify or amend

questions: Are there temples near the site?

There's an IT park within ten kilometres and several temples nearby.

Hotel Haribhavanam, Hotel Anandas, Hotel Kannappa, Thalappakatti, Dominos, KFC

entries.answer: It's built as a premium township where daily life happens inside: parks for morning walks, play areas for children, shopping streets, dining and a community that gathers. Everything within walking distance instead of scattered across the city.

Children's play areas and parents pavilion
Walking tracks and morning walk spaces

questions: Where does Karthipuram fit in Coimbatore's growth?
Is Coimbatore a good city to invest in?
entries.answer: Coimbatore is called the Manchester of South India. The city has grown in stages, from the Race Course area in 1815 to Town Hall, RS Puram and Gandhipuram, and Karthipuram is positioned as the next chapter in 2025.
facts: Coimbatore, the Manchester of South India
2025 Karthipuram, Coimbatore's well planned integrated township
